newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Regis EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Regis EPS view cut.

text.p: -- Piper Jaffray analyst Saul Yaari said Friday he cut his earnings estimate for Regis Corp to $0.20 a share from $0.30 for the second quarter ending in December. A year ago, it earned $0.17 a share, restated for its Supercuts acquisition.
-- He also cut his fiscal 1997 earnings estimate to $0.94 a share from $1.18 a share, compared with $0.80 a year ago.
-- Yaari said lower earnings reflect a shortfall in sales, particularly of retail hair care products at its salons.
